findings.summary: Spec §验收 requires all four acceptance commands (npm ci / npm run typecheck / npm test / npm run smoke:cas) to be green. The committed acceptance evidence .dd-evidence/acceptance.json records "passed": false with npm test exit_code=1 (1 failed | 876 passed, 877 total). The failing test is test/a10b-convergence.test.ts > B2 'real end-to-end harvest publishes evidence readable back from the channel' which timed out at 30000ms. The discriminating C5 tests are present, and the bounded-but-sufficient round-budget + zero_report sentinel changes match the spec, but the acceptance gate as a whole did not go green, so '四命令全绿' is not satisfied.
